name: web-dark-glass-404-page-with-chrome-gradient-numerals-and-crypto-cta
title: Black 404 in silver-gradient numerals behind a frosted card, plus a glass CTA and footer with a chrome swirl
whatItIs: A pure black page with a thin nav, giant thin '404' fading from silver to dark, a frosted glass card 'Oops, page not found' with a glass button, below a wide glass CTA panel 'Try the crypto wallet of the future, today.' with a blue-chrome swirl rising through it and a multi-column footer.
whatItMeans: Sleek and premium; glass and chrome make even an error page feel expensive.
techniques: Use thin numerals with a metallic gradient.
Overlay a frosted card on the numerals.
Run a chrome swirl across CTA and footer.
Keep everything black, grey and blue.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent button with a subtle sheen.
A card laid over large numerals.
